primary_item.title: 新基准测试证实 AI 模型在视觉感知方面仍表现不佳 / New benchmark confirms AI models still perform poorly at visual perception
primary_item.title_zh: 新基准测试证实 AI 模型在视觉感知方面仍表现不佳
primary_item.title_en: New benchmark confirms AI models still perform poorly at visual perception
primary_item.title_original: New benchmark confirms AI models still perform poorly at visual perception
primary_item.summary:
Moonshot AI's PerceptionBench tests how well multimodal AI models can actually "see," separate from logical reasoning. No frontier model reaches 60 percent accuracy, and GPT-5.6 Sol leads by a narrow margin. Many supposed reasoning errors actually happen as early as the image-reading stage.
Moonshot AI's PerceptionBench tests how well multimodal AI models can actually "see," separate from logical reasoning. No frontier model reaches 60 percent accuracy, and GPT-5.6 Sol leads by a narrow margin.
primary_item.recommend_reason_zh: Moonshot AI发布的PerceptionBench将视觉感知拆为十项技能，测试显示16个前沿模型无一达到60%，最高GPT-5.6 Sol为59.7%，幻觉类是最弱项，它仅26.9%。这揭示许多“推理错误”发生在图像读取阶段。

primary_item.title_original: World Labs turns one real-world robot task into thousands of simulated variations for training
primary_item.summary:
World Labs, the startup founded by AI pioneer Fei-Fei Li, has unveiled a simulation engine that trains robot controllers entirely in virtual environments. From a single real-world task, the system generates thousands of controlled variations. The trained models then ran for one hour each on five different robot platforms without human intervention. How well the results hold up in more complex everyday situations remains to be seen.

primary_item.summary:
We’ve released multiple updates to the OAuth app and GitHub App platforms to support more secure app development: OAuth apps can opt in to expiring access tokens and refresh tokens.…
We’ve released multiple updates to the OAuth app and GitHub App platforms to support more secure app development:
OAuth apps can now request a short-lived token during the user authentication flow. If an app opts in, they get an access token that lives for eight hours and a refresh token that’s valid for six months.
primary_item.recommend_reason_zh: GitHub为OAuth应用推出八小时短期访问令牌与六个月刷新令牌，并支持注册最多10个redirect URIs，新增通配符匹配但需警惕滥用风险。

items.summary_zh: GitHub 更新 OAuth 应用与 GitHub App 平台：OAuth 应用可选用短期访问令牌（8 小时）和刷新令牌（6 个月），并支持注册最多 10 个重定向 URI，新
items.why_it_matters: 短期令牌降低泄露风险，刷新令牌延长会话；多 URI 和通配符简化多环境配置，但通配符可能引入回调劫持，开发者需评估安全影响。

angles.risk: 未亲测通配符匹配的实际行为和安全限制，需核实通配符是否支持子域名及校验规则。

items.summary_zh: 据路透社援引消息人士，Anthropic预计2028年营收达1900亿至2000亿美元，而5月年化营收为470亿美元。银行家与投资者已按其IPO前景定价。此预测未经官方证实。
items.why_it_matters: Anthropic的高营收预期将影响Claude API定价、企业采购决策和开发者对平台长期稳定性的信心。
